notes: Custom on time means arrival delay ≤15 minutes; the official BTS boundary differs at exactly 15 minutes.
Arrival rates exclude cancelled, diverted and missing-delay observations. Cancellation and diversion rates use all scheduled observations.
October includes 486,165 unresolved numeric airport IDs. Totals retain them; route and airport codes are not harmonized across the year.
Ranked routes and airports require at least 1,000 scheduled observations within the selected cohort. Rankings show up to 20 entries, not all routes.
Recorded attribution minutes are source categories, not proven root cause or achievable savings. One row is a source observation, not a guaranteed unique physical flight.
validation: All 5,819,079 observations retained; 5,714,008 eligible arrivals and 4,690,510 custom on-time arrivals match python_kpi_summary.csv.
Weighted rates and mean delay are calculated from summed numerators and denominators, never averages of rates.
Carrier/month selections, route and airport ranks, departure hours and recorded attribution all derive from the same processed flight fact.
